metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 1980 · Friday the 13th
metas.description: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.1 · 1981 · Friday the 13th: Part 2
metas.description: Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.6 · 1982 · Friday the 13th: Part 3
metas.description: Jason Voorhees stalks a group of friends who have just arrived to spend the weekend at a cabin near Crystal Lake.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.0 · 1984 · Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
metas.description: After being announced dead and taken to a morgue, Jason Voorhees spontaneously revives, escapes from the hospital, and stalks a group of friends renting a house in the countryside near Crystal Lake.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.8 · 1985 · Friday the 13th: A New Beginning
metas.description: Still haunted by his past, Tommy Jarvis, who, as a child, killed Jason Voorhees, is sent to a secluded halfway house in the countryside, where the killing of a young man triggers a brutal series of murders in the area.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.0 · 1986 · Friday the 13th Part VI: Jason Lives
metas.description: Tommy Jarvis exhumes Jason Voorhees to cremate his corpse, but inadvertently brings him back to life instead. The newly revived killer seeks revenge, and Tommy may be the only one who can stop him.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.2 · 1988 · Friday the 13th: The New Blood
metas.description: Jason Voorhees is accidentally freed from his watery prison by a telekinetic teenager. Now, only she can stop him.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 4.5 · 1989 · Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
metas.description: Jason Voorhees is accidentally awakened from his watery grave and ends up stalking a ship full of graduating high-school students headed to Manhattan, New York.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 4.1 · 1993 · Jason Goes to Hell: The Final Friday
metas.description: Serial killer Jason Voorhees' supernatural origins are revealed.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 4.5 · 2001 · Jason X
metas.description: Jason Voorhees is cryogenically frozen at the beginning of the 21st century, and is discovered in the 25th century and taken to space. He gets thawed, and begins stalking and killing the crew of the spaceship that's transporting him.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 5.8 · 2003 · Freddy vs. Jason
metas.description: Freddy Krueger and Jason Voorhees return to terrorize the teenagers of Elm Street. Only this time, they're out to get each other, too.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 5.5 · 2009 · Friday the 13th
metas.description: A group of young adults visit a boarded up campsite named Crystal Lake where they soon encounter the mysterious Jason Voorhees and his deadly intentions.
